violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: Observed no certified food manager present during the inspection but food was not being delivered or served.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EHS REMINDED THE PIC THAT THE CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER SHALL BE PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION TO INCLUDE WHEN FOOD IS DELIVERED AND WHEN FOOD IS SERVED TO KIDS. DIRECTOR STATED THE CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER WOULD BE BACK BEFORE LUNCH TIME SERVICE.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. Observed no employee illness reporting agreement signed by staff.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information emailed at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. EHS HAS EMAILED THE EMPLOYEE ILLNESS REPORTING AGREEMENT TO MANAGEMENT. ALL STAFF HANDLING FOOD SHALL SIGN AND ACKNOWLEDGE THE POLICY. THIS CAN BE ACCOMPLISHED AS A SIGN UP SHEET WHERE ALL STAFF READ THE POLICY AND THEN SIGN ON ONE PIECE OF PAPER THAT THEY ACKNOWLEDGE THE POLICY WITH A DATE. THEN SEND ME THE SIGN UP SHEET VIA EMAIL.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PERSON IN CHARGE (PIC) TO PROVIDE SOAP.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PIC TO PROVIDE PAPER TOWELS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: Observed the hot water at the 3-vat sink only measuring 95f and then dropped in temperature dramatically.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PIC TO ENSURE THE HOT WATER AT THE 3-VAT SINK IS MAINTAINED AT 110F AT ALL TIMES. ENSURE CORRECTION IN LESS THAN 10 DAYS. SEND A PICTURE BY EMAIL OF YOUR DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER UNDER THE RUNNING HOT WATER TO SHOW THAT IT MEETS 110F OR ABOVE NO LATER THEN 10/2/2025.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Observed the employee restroom door not self closing as required.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PIC TO INSTALL A SELF CLOSING DOOR HINGE ON THE EMPLOYEE RESTROOM DOOR. SEND A PICTURE BY EMAIL NO LATER THAN 10/2/2025 SHOWING THE CORRECTION. BAILEY'S CHILDCARE & LEARNING CENTER (Inspection Date: 09/24/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floor to Wall Junctures Coved, Closed
violations.observation: Observed no “coving” or base board paneling along the base of the wall below the 3-vat sink. This was indicated in the comments section of the pre-occupancy inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Coving or base board paneling shall be installed on the wall behind the grease trap and below the 3-vat sink. EHS INSTRUCTED THE PIC THAT THIS WAS A COMMENT DURING THE PRE-OCCUPANCY INSPECTION THAT REQUIRED CORRECTION BEFORE THIS FIRST ROUTINE FOOD SAFETY INSPECTION. ENSURE CORRECTION AND SEND A PICTURE BY EMAIL NO LATER THAN 10/2/2025.
